name: Saint Christopher-Nevis-Anguilla (1967–1983)
description: A vertical tricolour of green, yellow and blue, charged at the centre with a black palm tree with three roots and three fronds.
history: Adopted on 27 February 1967 when Saint Christopher-Nevis-Anguilla became an Associated State of the United Kingdom, its three stripes and three-rooted palm standing for the three islands. Anguilla broke away within months, and the flag was retired when Saint Kitts and Nevis became independent under a new flag on 19 September 1983.

features.symbolism: green for Saint Kitts, yellow for Nevis and blue for Anguilla

features.role: palm tree with three roots and three fronds
features.symbolism: the three islands of the state
